out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED MAXIMUM HOT WATER TEMPERATURE AT HAND SINK TO RIGHT OF 3 COMPARTMENT SINK AT 70F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F. ADJUST HOT WATER SO HAND SINK IS AT LEAST 100F.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHELL EGGS STORED ON SHELF ABOVE BEAN SPROUTS IN WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. RAW SHELL EGGS MOVED TO SHELF BELOW BEAN SPROUTS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination

violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. INSTALL A SPLASH GUARD TO SHIELF BOTTOM SHELF PREP TABLE FOOD CONTENTS FROM SPLASH FROM MOP SINK.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: KIMCHI, RADISH KIMCHI IN WIC PREPARED 2 DAYS PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM MARKED CONTAINERS WITH DATE PREPARED.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: COOKED MACKEREL.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EHS HAD CFM LABEL MACKEREL LABELLED WITH 4 HOUR END POINT OF 2:00PM.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. OBSERVED WET WIPING CLOTH STORED ON PREP UNIT, ON COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CFM AGREED TO STORE WET WIPING CLOTHS IN SANITIZER SOLUTION. EHS RECOMMENDED PLACING A CONTAINER OF SANITIZER SOLUTION AT EACH STATION.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: OBSERVED OUTDOOR TRASH RECEPTACLE WITH DOORS OPEN.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. CFM CLOSED DOORS OF TRASH RECEPTACLE.
